title: The Photo Engine (Media Organizer & Lightroom) WordPress plugin before 6.6.2 does not sanitise and escape keyword…
description: The Photo Engine WordPress plugin versions before 6.6.2 do not properly sanitize and escape keyword names before storing and displaying them on a debugging page. This flaw allows users with the Author role and above to perform stored cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks against administrators who view the debugging page.
